title: docs(plugin-designer): point the five `.at()`/`lib` test comments at the census instead of restating its answer
body:
Fixes #9513

Five comments in `packages/plugin-designer` justified index arithmetic by writing down an ES `lib` level. All five went false together when objectui#9512 raised the `lib` level of the per-package test tsconfigs, so all five are repaired in one pass.

## The enumeration — my own sweep, not an inherited list

I enumerated the package myself rather than taking the card's list. Population: every file under `packages/plugin-designer/` (all extensions, node_modules excluded). Three independent token passes, each with a nonsense-token control reading 0 in the same command: the token `ES2022` (6 hits — 5 comments plus `tsconfig.test.json`'s own data), the token `at(-1)` (5 hits), and a comment-line-only pass over `ES2020` / `type-check` / `Array.prototype` / `lib` / "last element" / "length - 1". The three passes converge on the same five sites.

**The card's list of five is exactly right — no sixth, and none of the five was a miss.** One nearby file, `DashboardDesignPage.rootTitleRetired.test.tsx`, carries no claim of this family in any pass.

| file | the sentence, verbatim | on my base |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `src/__tests__/DashboardEditor.i18nTitle.test.tsx` | "the repo compiles at `target`/`lib` `ES2020` (root `tsconfig.json`), and `Array.prototype.at` is ES2022 — so `.at()` type-checks nowhere in this repo" | **FALSE** |
| `src/__tests__/DashboardEditor.rootTitleRetired.test.tsx` | "Index arithmetic, not `.at(-1)`: this package's `lib` predates ES2022." | **FALSE** |
| `src/MetadataFieldsPage.retiredIndexed.test.tsx` | "this package's tsconfig `lib` predates ES2022, so `Array.prototype.at` does not type-check here." | **FALSE** |
| `src/MetadataFieldsPage.specKeyReference.test.tsx` | (identical to the above) | **FALSE** |
| `src/MetadataFieldsPage.specKeySystem.test.tsx` | (identical to the above) | **FALSE** |

⚠️ One path correction for the record: the dispatch named the surface as `packages/plugin-designer/src/__tests__/`, but **three of the five live directly in `packages/plugin-designer/src/`**, not in `__tests__/`. Both directories are inside the same test program — `tsconfig.test.json`'s `include` is `src/**` glob for `.test.ts` and `.test.tsx` — which is why one measurement settles all five.

## Falsity is measured, not assumed

`.at(-1)` was substituted at all five sites and the test program compiled. Three legs, one script, with a `trap` restoring on every exit path:

```
injected-text count BEFORE = 0        index-arithmetic count BEFORE = 5
injected-text count AFTER  = 5        <- the edit provably landed on disk
LEG A  tsc -p tsconfig.test.json  exit=0   TS2550 hits: 0
LEG B  FIRING CONTROL, same command, one deliberate type error injected:
       exit=2  error TS2322: Type 'number' is not assignable to type ...
LEG C  all 5 files byte-match their HEAD blob; git diff HEAD line count = 0
```

Leg A is the finding: `.at()` **does** type-check in this package's test program today. Leg B proves the reader could have shown a failure. Leg C proves nothing of the measurement survived into this diff.

The `lib` half of the census confirms the wider picture is a **distribution, not a constant** — some packages sit at es2022, some still at es2020. That is precisely why neither "nowhere" nor a list of names is a safe thing to write down.

## The repair is a pointer

Following AGENTS.md commandment #9 and the precedent already in the tree — objectui#9504 replaced the count in `scripts/vitest-invocation-guard.mjs`'s own docblock with a pointer to its pin test — each sentence now names **`pnpm census:tsconfig-test-parity`** and its `lib` section instead of restating an answer that moves.

**Zero new counts and zero new package lists — measured on this diff, not intended.**

- Every digit-bearing token in the added lines, the complete population: `objectui#9513` x5 (an issue reference), `ES2022` x5, and `1` x5 (the literal inside `.at(-1)`). The latter two each appear **5 times in the removed lines too** — carried over, not introduced. `ES2020` appears once in the removed lines and **zero** times in the added lines.
- Workspace package names in the added lines: matched against all 47 workspace package names plus all 47 package directory names, word-boundary. Two hits, both ordinary English words colliding with a directory name — "esbuild strips **types** without checking them" and "re-learned at the next call **site**". Each appears once in the added lines and **once in the removed lines**, so neither is new. Control: appending one line that names two real packages takes the same matcher from 2 to 4.

## Comments only — proven

```
git diff -U0 vs base: 52 changed lines (38 added, 14 removed)
changed lines that are NOT a comment line, either direction = 0
CONTROL: the same predicate over the same input plus one known
         non-comment line returns 1
```

The `lastSchema` helper and the four sibling expressions are **byte-unchanged**. No assertion, fixture, import or test name moved. Ruling 3 respected: whether to switch to `.at(-1)` now that the level is raised is a separate, optional call and is not taken here.

## Verification

All run in a dedicated worktree; dependency closure built first, because `paths` is emptied in this package's test config so `@object-ui/*` resolves through built `.d.ts`.

| check | result |
|:--|:--|
| `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-designer/` | **21 files / 159 tests passed** |
| firing control for that suite (one expected value flipped, then restored byte-identically) | **exit 1, 1 failed** |
| `tsc --noEmit` (source half of `type-check`) | exit 0 |
| `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` (test half) | exit 0 |
| firing control for that command | **exit 2** |
| `eslint` over the five files | exit 0 |
| `pnpm check:new-line-citations` | exit 0 — "0 new citation(s)" |
| `pnpm check:control-bytes` | exit 0 |
| `pnpm check:comment-mask-corpus` | exit 0, within the held-open residue |
| `pnpm check:changeset-claims` | exit 0 |
| `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` | exit 0 |
| `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` over all six paths | NOT GOVERNED (control: `AGENTS.md` refuses) |

`gates_weakened:` **NONE.** This diff is prose; nothing about what any gate checks changed.

## ⚠️ One declared deviation from the stated file surface

The dispatch said comments only, no other file. `scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` **refuses** a diff touching five `src/` files of a released package with no declaration — measured, exit 1, message quoted in the report. The gate's own text names an **empty frontmatter** as the explicit first-class pass for a test-only change, so `.changeset/9513-at-lib-prose-pointer.md` carries one: it declares that **no package is released**. That is a sixth file, outside the stated surface, and it is flagged here rather than slipped in. Dropping it would leave this PR red on a gate it cannot otherwise satisfy.
